en.title: Minimum Chunks Required
en.description:
A file contains totalPackets packets numbered 1-based. The uploaded ranges do not overlap; each contiguous range not yet uploaded can be split into any number of contiguous chunks, where each chunk length must be a non-negative integer power of 2, and the chunk start does not need to be aligned to its length. Find the minimum number of chunks still to be uploaded.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains totalPackets and m; each of the next m lines contains an uploaded closed range l r. Original limits: 1≤totalPackets<10^18, 0≤m<10^5, 1≤l≤r≤totalPackets, and the ranges do not overlap.
en.output: Output the minimum number of chunks that must be uploaded.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: Sort the uploaded ranges and find the non-uploaded gaps between them one by one. A gap of length L can be split into at least popcount(L) chunks with power-of-two lengths, and the answer is the sum of popcount over all gaps.
